label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Engagement Rate
body: Engagement rate measures how much your audience interacts with your content, like likes, comments, and shares, compared to how many people saw it.
caption:
For creators, freelancers, and small sellers, a good engagement rate shows that your content is really resonating with your audience, not just being seen. It helps you understand if your posts are sparking interest and conversations. If your engagement is low, maybe try different types of content or ask more questions to get people talking. Keep an eye on what works best for your community! 👋
